Subject: [pve-smart-alert] WARNING pve1: monitoring 2 drives, 1 finding
Field event: first-run
Field hostname: pve1
Field type: pve-smart-alert

PVE SMART Alert now monitors the drives of pve1. This summary lists what it
found. From now on a problem is reported once, again when it gets worse, and
as a reminder after a while.

Host:       pve1 (cluster: lab)

Monitored drives:
  /dev/sdb [sat] Samsung SSD 870 EVO 1TB (ANON-SN-0001)
    WARNING   ata.reallocated_sectors: 8
  /dev/nvme0 [nvme] WDC PC SN720 SDAPNTW-512G (ANON-SN-0002)  no findings

Devices without usable data:
  /dev/sdz [sat]: No such device

Skipped devices:
  /dev/sdc [sat]: excluded (model = "QEMU*")

What to do:
  A counter that keeps increasing indicates a failing drive. Plan a
  replacement of the drive and make sure its data is backed up.

This message also shows that notifications reach you. It is sent once; it can
be switched off with first_run_summary = false in [notify] of
/etc/pve-smart-alert/config.toml.

pve-smart-alert 0.4.0 on pve1
